editorial:
Imagine dating a woman who can fly, stop time, and lift a building, but then imagine breaking up with her. That is exactly the mess Matt finds himself in. He thinks he is just dating a normal girl, but Jenny is actually G-Girl, a superhero who keeps her powers a secret. When Matt dumps her, he quickly learns that having an ex with god-like powers is a total nightmare. The vibe is light, silly, and full of chaotic energy as she uses her abilities to prank him and ruin his day in the funniest ways possible.

You will love the chemistry between the leads and the creative ways the special effects are used for jokes rather than just big fights. The pacing moves quickly, though some of the humor feels a bit dated since it came out in 2006. If you want something easy to watch that does not take itself too seriously, this is a great pick.
endingExplained: After a lot of fighting and jealousy, Jenny realizes that her powers do not make a relationship work. Matt proves he actually loves her for who she is, not just because she is a superhero. They decide to give their romance another shot and make up. The movie wraps up with them happily back together, showing that love is more powerful than any superpower and that being honest is the best way to start over.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves romantic comedies with a weird twist.
